name: [forge-admin] push provider_auth_failed — the Expo credential was refused
message:
The push provider refused the worker's credential, so every row in the chunk failed and the run stopped.

This should never fire. Check EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN on the @forge/admin worker service only: the token is a Railway variable there and never in the shared Doppler config. A rotated or revoked token, or a token that reached admin web instead of the worker, produces this line.

The log line carries provider_code and never the provider's message, because that message embeds the push token. Set PUSH_CAMPAIGNS_ENABLED=false and cancel the campaign before you rotate.
